title: The Underground
subtitle: A place rather than a task list
description: Every questline in this collection ends in the dark somewhere, and
this one is where the dark starts. Below the grass the hill keeps a
corridor of its own, older than the road and cooler than the road
and considerably less interested in you.
There is nothing to carry here and nothing to press. Arrive, and the
quest agrees you have arrived -- the first of the place-tasks, which
count where you are rather than what you hold.
